description: This file defines a Validator class for schema validation of UI component messages, including schema validation, custom validation, and error reporting.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: A class for validating message components against JSON schemas, with custom validation logic and error reporting.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Validator with schemas and optional output directory.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs validation on an array of results, returning validated results with errors.

methods.name: saveFailure
methods.description: Saves validation failure details to a YAML file in the output directory.

methods.name: validateCustom
methods.description: Performs custom validation checks such as referential integrity and presence of root component.

methods.name: validateUpdateComponents
methods.description: Validates updateComponents message structure and component references.

methods.name: validateUpdateDataModel
methods.description: Validates updateDataModel message structure and conditional 'value' property.

methods.name: validateComponent
methods.description: Validates individual component properties and references.
